image_description: An underwater shot of a hammerhead shark swimming in blue water. The shark is viewed from a high angle, showing its dorsal side. The distinctive cephalofoil (hammer head) is visible but partially obscured by lighting and water turbidity. Several smaller fish are swimming in the background. The image has a strong blue cast typical of underwater photography.
